editions.name: Gilded Waywatch
editions.reference: User-provided stylized treasure chest screenshot used as a visual inspiration only; screenshot artwork is not embedded or reused
details: Secondary UV wood/enamel normal finishing
Source base-color atlases and UVs preserved
Scored board joints and fine brushed-metal normal maps
Long-fiber albedo grain, warped knots and dark board joints reinforce the acquired source UV timber artwork.
Authored layered edge rails, corner shoes, domed fasteners and physical rear hinges on the acquired source shell.
Side handle backplates are fitted by raycast to the actual body; rolled handles include mounting bolts and a hinge pin.
Curved lid band inlays are sampled from source lid geometry and follow the real Lid pivot.
Authored hardware is joined into separate rigid Body and Lid batches, preserving source shell meshes and material slots.
Theme-specific crafted trim: gilded-waywatch.
Broad brass corner blocks, domed bolted iron straps and a pierced scalloped receiver frame the timber.
An enlarged raised compass rosette, cast leaf scrolls and nested engraved ring create the ornate central lock.
The acquired center clasp and sourced tongue/receiver use cast-brass finish, exposing the scalloped hero lock below the opening seam.
Reference-led hero ornament, detailed albedo wood grain and differentiated crafted armor complete the acquired source shell
Fitted source-connected KayKit keyplate with moving tongue and fixed receiver; KayKit original clasp retained on its own shell
Source wood grain and secondary normal detail baked into the optimized runtime atlas

optimization.method: Decimate added hardware; retain source shells; two rigid mesh batches; full single-UV PBR bake; embedded PNG1024color/1024normal/256ORM/512emission; no required compression extensions

visual_reference.rights: Unknown original screenshot rights; screenshot pixels are not runtime artwork

editions.animation_authorship: New rigid Lid hinge Open and Close clips, 61 sampled keys over one second; acquired source clips not reused
